messages:
maria (devex): Edge sample build failing with 'Unexpected token export' only when installed from registry in our pnpm monorepo. Local dev (pnpm link) works. anyone seen this interplay between pnpm symlinks + package.exports?
ryan (eng-runtime): sounds like the bundler picked a CJS file or a non-transpiled file. check conditional exports and that the published tarball actually contains your esm output.
sam (pkg-maintainer): checked package.json: we had a wildcard exports mapping to dist/cjs ("./*": "./dist/cjs/*") and "." -> dist/cjs/index.js. oops. that explains it.
jade (ts): also watch the "types" field. TS in a workspace will resolve symlinked paths differently. set "types" to the shipped entry (e.g. dist/esm/index.d.ts) so editors/consumers see the right declarations.
maria (devex): pasted snippet (redacted): "exports": {"./*": "./dist/cjs/*", ".": "./dist/cjs/index.js"} — will switching to conditional exports fix it?
sam (pkg-maintainer): yes, change root export to {"import":"./dist/esm/index.js","require":"./dist/cjs/index.js"} and remove the wildcard that overrides subpaths. republishing now.
ci-bot: npm publish started for package@0.3.2 (build 412) :package:
maria (devex): thanks. aside: any app-side mitigations if we hit similar again?
ryan (eng-runtime): app bundlers should respect exports conditionals; for edge deploys make sure resolution mainFields includes 'exports' and 'module' before 'main'. for webpack/rollup set mainFields: ['exports','module','main'] or equivalent.
jade (ts): grep to catch bad packages in monorepo: rg '"\.": "./dist/cjs' --glob '!node_modules'
sam (pkg-maintainer): added a prepublish script to assert dist/esm exists and exports has import/require. will add to PR template.
maria (devex): redeploying edge sample now. will add checklist to sample-app README. :white_check_mark:
